note: Wikidata q-ids only. Pick the BUILDING, never the institution — 'Hellenic Parliament' (Q477089) is a legislature and its coordinate is not a door. Q7084890 is the building it sits in. Two entries in the first pass graded D and were replaced rather than nudged; the reason is written on each of them below.

places.name: Benaki Toy Museum
places.note: Replaces the Hellenic Children's Museum (Q4159473), which graded D: its Wikidata point and its Wikipedia point sit 1159 m apart because the museum left Plaka and the two sources still record different addresses. This q-id is the toy museum's own building in Palaio Faliro, the Kouloura mansion, and it is a children's museum in everything but name.

places.name: Lycabettus summit, Agios Georgios
places.note: Replaces the hill item (Q1357713), which graded D as a viewpoint: a hill is a kilometre wide, so its centroid is nowhere a child actually stands and Wikipedia's point sat 747 m from it. Q12872113 is the chapel of Agios Georgios on the summit — the chosen viewpoint, and where the funicular arrives.
